title: metadata-protocol: a package-less item of a two-holder name is still served at both exact addresses on the draft and preview reads and for hook, job, queue, sharing_rule and assignment_rule (ADR-0150 D4, after #32407)
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYGYEUhpi29FpjLmxT

Parent: #31527 (ADR-0150, epic red line 2: ambiguity is reported, never guessed).
Found by: the dev of #32407 (PR #32566), measured, report 6815686715 `out_of_scope_findings`. Not re-measured by the seat.

## Premise

ADR-0150 D4 (epic ruling 6761802819 on #31699): a package-less row or environment item of a name two or more packages hold is no holder's own. Each holder's exact read refuses it with 409 naming every holder. PR #32566 applies this to `action` and every type narrowed to the namespace (`judgesPackageLessRows`), and to the layered read. Two locations of the same class remain.

1. **Draft and preview exits.** The strict draft read (`state: draft`) and the `previewDrafts` arm at `?package=X` return before `exactQualifierItem` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`, `readMetaItem`). A package-less draft row of an `email_template` name two packages hold is served at both exact addresses.
   - Re-check: on #32566's head, save a package-less draft of an `email_template` name alpha and beta both hold, then read it with `state=draft&package=alpha` and `&package=beta`. Both answer 200 today.
2. **Types with no one-holder rule.** `hook`, `job`, `queue`, `sharing_rule` and `assignment_rule` are bucket 2 types that ADR-0150 leaves without a backstop, so the registry takes one name from two packages. They are neither read by package nor narrowed, so `judgesPackageLessRows` does not judge them. A package-less environment item of such a name is served at both holders' `?package=`.
   - Re-check: `judgesPackageLessRows(registry, 'queue')` on #32566's head returns false. Register `queue` `q1` from alpha and beta and a package-less environment item `q1`; both exact reads answer 200.

## Fix shape (seat's estimate)

- Run the draft and preview exits through `exactQualifierItem`, as the active read does.
- Judge a package-less item of every package-scoped type that two packages can hold. A one-holder name keeps serving it, as today. The simplest form may be to judge every package-scoped type, since a type with an environment one-holder rule never has two holders. The dev measures that before choosing.
- Sweep every other exact-read exit for the same early return (history, versions, layers, list).
- Each moved answer is declared FROM → TO with its Clause-② arm (`narrowing`) and pinned, with one-holder CONTROLs. First-party count expected 0 (the #32407 census: 216 judged names, none held by two packages).

## Order

Lands after PR #32566 (same files). Same lane as #32407 (server seat 5).

Blocked-by: #32407
